    • delete

      public Boolean delete(String projectId, String permissionSetId, String lastRev)
      Description copied from interface: IAMPermissionSets
      Deletes a permission set.

      The spec requires the permission set's last-known revision in the request body for optimistic-concurrency-controlled deletion.

      Specified by:
      delete in interface IAMPermissionSets
      Parameters:
      projectId - the project identifier
      permissionSetId - the permission set identifier
      lastRev - the last-known revision of the permission set (required; from PermissionSet.getRev())
      Returns:
      true if the deletion request was accepted
